Young animals, PSLN-344 vs PSLN-212: Ifnb1 at 16 h 50.2x vs 37.5x (ratio 1.34, Welch p = 0.009, Tukey p = 0.63); cDC1 44.3% vs 43.4% (p = 0.75); antigen+ DC in lymph node 11.1% vs 9.4% (p = 0.14); ex vivo CD8 priming 31.4% vs 26.2% (p = 0.26).

Manganese adds more in aged than in young animals (two-way ANOVA, age x formulation; n = 5 per cell). Ifnb1 at 16 h: 2.23-fold in aged vs 1.34-fold in young, interaction p = 0.0004. Lung cDC1: +14.7 vs +0.8 points, p = 0.005. Antigen-bearing dendritic cells in lymph node: +5.3 vs +1.7 points, p = 0.010. Ex vivo CD8 priming: +17.9 vs +5.2 points, p = 0.011. Survival in young animals is already 24/24 without manganese, so it cannot show an advantage.
method: Interaction term of a two-way ANOVA on the scale used for each read-out (log10 for Ifnb1).

statement: Young animals challenged 180 days after vaccination (S09-G): lowest weight 87.3% with PSLN-344 vs 89.3% with PSLN-212 (Welch p = 0.028); day-14 weight 95.6% vs 99.2% (p = 0.004); n = 8. Two of the three young weight tables share whole-animal trajectories (see data-quality register).

cGAMP payload (CMP-204) in aged animals: Ifnb1 at 16 h 7.7x (PSLN-212 16.5x; PSLN-344 36.9x); IgG 181, HAI 23, neutralising 182 (geometric means, CA09 H1N1); survival after homologous challenge 3/7 (S03-I). CDN-1807 vs cGAMP in the same manganese-free liposome (PSLN-212 vs CMP-204): Ifnb1 ratio 2.15 (95% CI 1.65-2.81), Welch p = 0.0003; IgG ratio 2.17 (0.86-5.49), p = 0.090. No block combines cGAMP with manganese.

Adding the TLR7/8 agonist R848: PSLN-212/R848 gives a mean weight nadir of 90.0% after vaccination, 4 of 5 animals lose >= 10%, group mean still 90.7% on day 10 with only 4 of 5 animals recorded (S08-D); lung Il10 179x and Tnf 202x at 16 h vs 7.3x Il10 for PSLN-344 (S09-A); Ifnb1 at 16 h: PSLN-212/R848 24.0x vs 36.9x for PSLN-344 (S01-A); a preparation labelled PSLN-344/R848 gives 29.4x at 20 ug vs 45.8x for PSLN-344 (S08-A; this preparation is not defined in the annotation).

Dose-response of lung Ifnb1 at 16 h (S08-A; n = 3 per dose; age of animals not stated): PSLN-344 1.4 / 8.3 / 21.1 / 45.8 / 50.2-fold at 1 / 5 / 10 / 20 / 40 ug; fitted Emax 58-fold (95% CI 47-74) and ED50 13 ug (10-18); PSLN-212 Emax 16-fold (13-20), ED50 11 ug. 40 vs 20 ug: ratio 1.10, Welch p = 0.55. A PSLN-344 dose of about 6.6 ug is predicted to match the 20-ug PSLN-212 response (12.6-fold).
method: Emax model fitted on log10 scale; parametric-bootstrap CIs

statement: Body weight after intranasal vaccination without challenge (S08-D, n = 5): PSLN-344 mean nadir 96.4% of baseline (worst animal 94.2%), 98.6% on day 8 and 99.8% on day 10; vaccine alone 98.2%; difference -1.8 points (95% CI -3.7 to 0.1), Welch p = 0.065. PSLN-212 aged 97.0%, PSLN-212 young 97.6%, CMP-204 95.9%.
method: Per-animal nadir over days 2-10

statement: Lung cytokine mRNA 16 h after adjuvant alone (S09-A, columns A-V; stored as log10; geometric-mean fold vs untreated; n = 3): aged PSLN-344 Il6 36x, Tnf 40x, Ccl2 590x (aged PSLN-212 Ccl2 7.6x, a 77-fold difference), Il10 7.3x. Relative to young PSLN-212: Il6 0.60-fold (p = 0.34), Ccl2 0.42-fold (p = 0.22), Tnf 2.9-fold (p = 0.009), Il10 4.0-fold (p = 0.021).
method: values are log10 in the workbook; back-transformed; Welch tests on the stored scale

statement: Lung cytokine mRNA at 72 h (S09-A, columns X-AS; printed '16h' but its Ifnb1 row reproduces the 72-h values of S01-A): aged PSLN-344 Tnf 8.4x, Il6 7.2x, Il10 4.2x, Ccl2 27x; aged PSLN-212 Tnf 5.2x, Il6 1.9x, Il10 4.2x; young PSLN-212 Tnf 0.5x, Il6 3.1x, Il10 0.1x. PSLN-344 vs young: Tnf 18-fold (p = 0.008), Il6 2.3-fold (p = 0.085); PSLN-344 vs aged PSLN-212: Tnf 1.6-fold (p = 0.052), Il6 3.9-fold (p = 0.026). n = 3.

CNS transcripts 36 h after intranasal dosing (S10-A, n = 5; ratio of geometric means): PSLN-344 vs buffer - Ifnb1 1.30 (95% CI 0.84-2.01), Tnf 1.57 (1.05-2.34; Welch p = 0.033, not adjusted for the six comparisons), Isg15 1.16 (0.79-1.72); PSLN-344 vs vaccine + empty liposome - 1.14, 1.20 (CI 0.77-1.87), 1.08; cholera toxin vs buffer - 5.5, 3.4, 2.7. 'Buffer' is the group printed as PBS; under the annotation's general rule it received buffer alone, although the block description lists only vaccine-containing conditions.
method: log10 scale; Welch intervals

statement: Encapsulation efficiency (S08-B, three preparations each): PSLN-344 54.8% (range 49.3-59.4%; CV 9%); PSLN-212 59.6%; CMP-204 65.2%. The method is stated as absorbance of CDN-1807 at 260 nm, yet values are also reported for PSLN-R848, which contains no CDN-1807. Particle size, zeta potential, morphology and stability are described in the annotation but no such data are in the workbook.

Animals per group for 90% power (two-sided alpha 0.05, Fisher exact): 11 at the observed 84% vs 12%; 18 if the true rates are 70% vs 15%; 43 against a comparator that achieves 50% (34 for 80% power); 13 for the day-60 contrast (67% vs 5%). For titres (pooled within-group SD 0.80 log2 from S03-C/D/G/H): 15 per group to detect a 2-fold difference, 5 for 4-fold.
cells: S03!K3:O7; S03!Q3:U7; S03!K10:O14; S03!Q10:U14 (SD); survival counts as L01-L02, L10
method: exact enumeration of the binomial outcomes; t-test power for titres

statement: Separation of the two protected groups (aged PSLN-344, young PSLN-212) from the two unprotected groups (aged PSLN-212, Sham), animal by animal: complete in 27 of 33 single-time-point read-outs that contain all four groups. Examples (highest unprotected value / lowest protected value): HAI to H1N1 80 / 160; IFN-g+ CD8 at day 14 2.17% / 5.18%; Ifnb1 at 16 h 19.0x / 32.6x; CCR7+ migratory DC 10.0% / 20.0%; Tfh:Tfr 4.4 / 6.6; lung resident-memory CD8 1.53% / 3.03%.
cells: all four-group scalar blocks (cells listed in immunology_descriptives.csv)
method: Group-level only: survival and biomarkers were measured in different animals.

statement: Multiplicity: of 43 single-time-point contrasts between aged PSLN-344 and aged PSLN-212 (printed quotient blocks and encapsulation efficiency excluded), 41 have Welch p < 0.05, 41 remain below 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment and 27 after Holm adjustment. Not significant: S01-A/72h, S04-C. With five animals per group the smallest attainable exact rank-test p is 0.008.
cells: all blocks containing both groups (cells in immunology_descriptives.csv)

statement: Stated n differs from the observations present in 5 blocks: S03-J (label n=9; 10 rows per group, one PSLN-344 row without a day), S05-A and S05-B (label n=3; 2 values per group and day), S09-F (label n=8; Sham has 7 rows - the annotation attributes this shortfall to S09-B, whose Sham column has 8), S13-E (label n=5; 7 rows per group).

Survival tables vs the body-weight tables recorded for the same animals (69 arm-level comparisons over 17 experiments): 47 agree in count and, within a two-day tolerance, in timing; 8 agree in count but not in timing; 9 differ in the number of deaths, 1 differs in the number of animals (S09-F/S09-G Sham, 7 vs 8) and 4 group labels exist in only one of the two tables (S03-I/S13-F: CMP-204 vs Naive; S03-J/S13-G: PSLN-212 vs Naive). Death-count differences (survivors per table / per weights): S03-I/S13-F PSLN-212 0/7 vs 3/7; S03-J/S13-G Sham 1/10 vs 5/10; S06-C/S15-C PSLN-212 2/7 vs 1/7; S06-D/S15-D PSLN-344 7/7 vs 5/7; S06-D/S15-D PSLN-212(Y) 7/7 vs 5/7; S06-E(r34)/S15-E PSLN-212 0/7 vs 1/7; S06-E(r34)/S15-E PSLN-344 5/7 vs 6/7; S06-G/S15-G PSLN-344 4/7 vs 5/7; S15-L/S15-M PSLN-212(Y) 6/7 vs 7/7.
cells: all survival blocks and all body-weight blocks on S03, S06, S09, S13, S15

statement: S06-C (bivalent vaccine, rgH5N1 at day 14) is identical to S06-D (same, day 3) in every one of its 28 rows: same day and same group flag for all four arms. The paired weight block S15-C implies 1/7 PSLN-212 survivors rather than 2/7, and its PSLN-344 columns for days 2-12 repeat the 'Vaccine + PSLN-344' columns of S15-I in 40 of 42 cells. The day-14 rgH5N1 experiment therefore has no independent record and is excluded from all pooled figures.

The printed IgG2a/IgG1 blocks S03-B and S03-F do not match their own source titres (S13-A to S13-D) under the printed headers; they match exactly when the headers are rotated (see L41). Read as printed they would show PSLN-344 as the most IgG1-skewed group; recomputed, PSLN-344 is IgG2a-skewed like young animals. A screen of all 41 single-time-point blocks that contain aged PSLN-212, aged PSLN-344 and young PSLN-212 finds the PSLN-344 mean between the other two in 38; the exceptions are these two blocks and the 72-h interferon block (S01-A), where aged animals on PSLN-344 are simply slower to return to baseline.

S09-A holds two panels both labelled '16h'. After back-transformation the Ifnb1 row of the second panel (columns X-AS) reproduces the 72-h values of S01-A for all seven groups, and the first panel reproduces the 16-h values (three of the five S01-A animals in each case). The second panel is treated as 72 h. The same control animals are called 'Sham' in S01-A and 'PBS' in S09-A.

Epithelial delivery of PSLN-344: S08-C as printed gives 3.8% dye-positive type-II cells for PSLN-344 vs 15.8% for the Mn-free liposome, and 13.8% type-I cells for the Mn-free liposome, whereas S01-B gives 3.8% type-I cells for the same Mn-free liposome. Columns A and B of S08-C share five exact values with the type-II and type-I columns of S01-B. The block is consistent with S01-B only if its headers are permuted; it is not used.

S11-A (alveolar macrophages) and S11-B (neutrophils) share 35 of 100 values in identical positions, including entire animal columns (S11!G3:G7 = G10:G14, L3:M7 = L10:M14, Q3:R7 = Q10:R14). They cannot both be independent measurements of different cell types; neither is used for inference, so the dataset contains no usable neutrophil read-out.

Body-weight tables reuse values across experiments: identical 8-animal rows for two different groups on day 12 of S09-C; whole-animal trajectories repeated between S09-E and S09-G, and between the PSLN-344 decedent of S15-A, S15-M and S15-O (85.1% carried forward from day 6 in all three strains); S15-A Sham day 4 equals S15-M PSLN-212 day 4 for all seven animals. 289 of 3472 weight cells carry more than one decimal, and the same four-digit fractions (e.g. .4231, .8791, .4744) recur with different integer parts in up to six blocks. These tables need to be regenerated from balance records.

Labels that prevent interpretation: S07-C (both groups headed 'Ly6C-CD206+'); two different experiments are each labelled S06-E and S06-F; S08 rows 89-101 hold 13 unlabelled values; 'PSLN-344/R848' in S08-A is not a defined material; the pertussis-toxin group of S02-C/S02-E has no stated adjuvant; challenge virus, dose and day are not stated for S15-L/S15-N, nor the challenge dose for S03-J; time points are not stated for S07-B, S11-E, S13-H, S14-A. S05-A/S05-B list two incompatible immunisation conditions and use an H-2Db tetramer although the default strain is BALB/c.

S07-A (Ly6C+CCR2+ macrophage time-course) is internally plausible but its direction is unconfirmed: as printed PSLN-344 has 5.6-fold fewer such cells than PSLN-212 on day 5, although PSLN-344 draws in about twice as many monocytes (S01-D), induces 77-fold more Ccl2 (S09-A) and its lungs contain 15% Ly6C+ macrophages in S07-B. No other block allows a cross-check, and S07-C on the same sheet is mislabelled. The block is reported but not used.
